'''2011 US Nationals Cooleo LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cooleo]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World|VB7-L-centeroftyranny-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Ryan (surname scribbled out)
* '''Deck name:''' Broken
* '''Username:''' coulco1c
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
